'''Hirshanin''' is a [[Ghealdan]]in soldier in [[Perrin Aybara]]'s camp.

==Activities==
Hirshanin is sent by [[Gerard Arganda]] to find a map of the [[Jehannah Road]] so that Perrin and Arganda can plan an ambush of the [[Whitecloak]]s.{{ref/book|13|40}}

== Trivia ==
* Hirshanin is named for James Hirsch, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
